title: Afɔrebɔ a Wogye tom wɔ Mmɔborohunu mu
intro: Mum w’ani na yɛ bon kɛse bi a ɛhɔ yɛ dinn a wɔasɔ gyidi ahwɛ akodu ne hye so ho mfonini wɔ w’adwenem. Worebɛhyia onipa bi a ne ho a ɔde brɛɛ ne ho ase brɛoo wɔ ahyɛde bi a wontumi nsusuw ho anim no danee sɔhwɛ bere tiaa bi bɛyɛɛ osetie ne ɔsoro mmɔborohunu daa sɛnkyerɛnne.
clues: Wɔkae me wɔ Kur’aan mu wɔ wɔn a wɔde boasetɔ a ɛyɛ pintinn gyinaa mu no mu.
Na mewɔ anisoadehunu bi a ɛsɔɔ ahobrɛaseɛ ma Allah ahyɛdeɛ hwɛeɛ no mfimfini.
Bere a wɔkaa anisoadehu no ho asɛm kyerɛɛ me no, mekae sɛ monyɛ sɛnea wɔahyɛ no na mubehu me wɔ ɔyarefo no mu.
Wɔde me too fam maa afɔrebɔ no, nanso Allah frɛɛ sɛ anisoadehunu no aba mu.
Allah de afɔrebɔ kɛseɛ gyee me, na ɔgyaa animuonyam maa me wɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdi akyire no mu.
Me ne Ismail, a ɔne Ibrahim maa Fie Kronkron no fapem so, a wɔkaa ne ho asɛm kaa Idris ne Dhul-Kifl ho wɔ ateneneefoɔ mu.
